title: "Sajday Main Sar Kata kay Shabbir Karbala Main"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]

---

Sajday main, sar kata kay, Shabbir Karbala main

Badli hai La Illah ki, taqdeer Karbala main

Asghar teray jihad ki, kiya dehe,r day misaal

Aye nazar lahu ki, taseer Karbala main

Touheed bach na paati, hota, na aaj parda

Laatay ager Hussain na, hamsheer Karbala main

Samjhi behen kay lout kay, Akbar, hai agaya

Gonjhi subhay Aashor jo, takbeer Karbala main

Thamay jigar ko apnay, Shabbi,r chun rahay hain

Bikhri howe Hasan ki, tasveer Karbala main

Deekha jo khawab Ahmed e, Mursal, ki ankh nay

Aus ko aata howe hai, tabeer Karbala main

Aik Maa kay dil main Shahid, paiwa,st aaj tak hai

Nikla tha jo kaman say, aik teer Karbala main

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/sajday-main-sar-kata-kay-shabbir-karbala-main-nw-f3180d8697f8.md && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from subprocess import check_output
p = 'src/data/lyrics/sajday-main-sar-kata-kay-shabbir-karbala-main-nw-f3180d8697f8.md'
original = check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True).split('---')[2].split()
_, front, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---')
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].strip()
assert roman.translate(str.maketrans('', '', '123456')).split() == original
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '123456'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵۶')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert len(blocks) == 7 and len(blocks[0]) == 2
    for block, number in zip(blocks[1:], numbers):
        assert len(block) == 3 and block[0].strip() == number
print('Verified the original Roman wording and 14 aligned verses.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu script in the selected lyric and preserved the original Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Verified that all 14 verses align across the opening couplet and six numbered stanzas. Updated the titles and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman forms `dehe,r` as `دہر` and `aata` as `عطا`.
